highlights.quote_receiving: The performance includes a one-time tariff refund benefit of $100 million.

highlights.amount: $24 million received (of $41 million total claims filed)
highlights.headline: Sonos received $24M in IEEPA tariff refunds in Q3; $23M recorded as GAAP gross profit benefit, $1M as interest income.
highlights.quote_receiving: Of the $41 million in claim we filed, we received $24 million in Q3. Of that amount, $23 million was principal recovery and recorded as a benefit to GAAP gross profit

highlights.headline: Sensata excludes potential IEEPA tariff refunds from Q3 guidance; no decision made on passing refunds to customers.
highlights.quote_receiving: Our third quarter guidance does not include any potential tariff refunds related to the recent IEEPA tariff rulings
highlights.quote_customers: nor does it reflect any possible pass-through of such refunds

highlights.headline: STERIS received $4M in tariff refunds in Q1; gross tariff costs were $14M, yielding net tariff favorability of $2M year-over-year.
highlights.quote_receiving: Tariff refunds of $4 million were received in the quarter. So on a year-over-year basis, net tariffs were favorable $2 million.

highlights.headline: Stanley Black & Decker received tariff refunds in Q2, contributing ~250 bps to adjusted gross margins; proceeds to be used for growth investments.
highlights.quote_receiving: We also received tariff refunds during the second quarter, which contributed to adjusted gross margins.

highlights.headline: Standex Scientific segment adjusted operating margin rose 440 bps YoY, partly reflecting tariff refunds received.
highlights.quote_receiving: Adjusted operating margin of 28.6% increased 440 basis points year-on-year, reflecting higher sales and tariff refunds.

highlights.headline: Sensient received ~$5M in tariff refunds in Q2 2026, mostly in Color Group; no significant additional refunds expected.
highlights.quote_receiving: The company received approximately $5 million of tariff refunds in the second quarter, most of which was in the Color Group, as Paul mentioned.

highlights.headline: Stryker received tariff refunds in Q2, partially driving EPS beat, offset by cyber-event costs.
highlights.quote_receiving: when we look at the beat in the quarter, it is driven partially by the tariff refunds that happened in the quarter

highlights.headline: Teledyne received tariff refunds in Q2, boosting Digital Imaging segment margin, nearly offset by higher R&D and other accruals.
highlights.quote_receiving: tariff refunds contributed to the strong margin the impact of refunds was nearly offset in dollar terms by the increase in R&D expense, inventory reserves and other accruals

highlights.headline: Terex received $8M IEEPA tariff refunds in Q2 2026, offset by a one-time unfavorable customs accrual; no future refunds being accrued.
highlights.quote_receiving: Adjusted earnings per share was $1.37 including a net benefit of $8 million from IEEPA tariff refunds, plus a onetime unfavorable customs-related accrual.

highlights.headline: Teleflex expects IEEPA tariff refunds but has not recognized any; guidance excludes benefit pending US government confirmation.
highlights.quote_receiving: We will recognize the tariff refund upon full confirmation from the US government.

highlights.headline: Timken received $8M net IEEPA tariff refunds in Q2 2026, contributing $0.08/share benefit to adjusted EPS.
highlights.quote_receiving: our adjusted results include a net benefit for IEEPA tariff refunds of $8 million or $0.08 per share

highlights.headline: Tractor Supply received tariff refunds in Q2 2025, using the benefit to invest in customer value/pricing rather than passing refunds directly to customers.
highlights.quote_receiving: Disciplined product cost management and benefits from tariff refunds more than offset pressure from higher freight expense and investments to strengthen our price-value position.

highlights.headline: Textron received a $21M gross IEEPA tariff refund at TSV (Industrial segment) in Q2 2026, with $18M net impact on results.
highlights.quote_receiving: We got a gross refund of IEEPA tariffs of $21 million for TSV. The net impact of that on the results was about $18 million.

highlights.headline: VF Corp received ~$50M tariff refund benefit in Q1 FY2027 free cash flow; full-year guidance excludes any further tariff refund benefit.
highlights.quote_receiving: This includes approximately $50 million benefit from tariff refunds.

highlights.headline: Versigent recognized approximately $7 million of IEEPA tariff refunds in Q2, boosting net performance.
highlights.quote_receiving: Net performance also included the recognition of approximately $7 million of IEEPA tariff refunds during the quarter.

highlights.headline: Cactus received ~$10M in IEEPA and unconstitutional tariff refunds in Q2, representing less than 15% of total tariffs paid over the relevant period.
highlights.quote_receiving: the receipt of initial reciprocal and fentanyl related tariff refunds. These refunds in the second quarter totaled approximately $10 million, which represents less than 15% of the total tariffs paid

highlights.headline: Dentsply Sirona received $44 million in tariff refunds in Q2 2026, contributing $0.17 per share and boosting operating cash flow.
highlights.quote_receiving: the benefit from $44 million in tariff refunds offset by a decline in gross profit, driven by lower volumes, sales mix and incremental tariff impacts.

highlights.headline: Zebra Technologies received $73 million IEEPA tariff recovery in Q2 2026, boosting adjusted gross margin by 540 basis points.
highlights.quote_receiving: Adjusted gross margin improved 540 basis points to 53.3%, largely due to the $73 million IEEPA tariff recovery that was not included in our outlook

highlights.headline: Zurn Elkay received $48M in IEEPA and reciprocal tariff refunds in Q2 2026, with ~$6M still uncollected.
highlights.quote_receiving: we received $48 million of cash related to IEEPA and reciprocal tariff refunds, inclusive of $2 million of accrued interest.

highlights.headline: Home Depot received $685M in IEEPA tariff refunds in Q2, used to offset rising cost pressures throughout the year.
highlights.quote_receiving: we received IEEPA tariff refunds which reduced our cost of goods sold by $685 million

highlights.headline: Trimble received tariff refunds in Q2 2026, creating a ~300 bps revenue headwind in Field Systems with offsetting COGS credit; no income impact.
highlights.quote_receiving: Field Systems revenue was up 12% in the quarter, despite a headwind of approximately 300 basis points due to tariff refunds, which we do not expect to materially impact future quarters.

highlights.headline: Lowe's received ~$80M in IEEPA tariff refunds in Q2, adding $0.11 to EPS; competitors used refunds to cut prices but Lowe's did not.
highlights.quote_receiving: GAAP diluted earnings per share and adjusted diluted earnings per share both include an $0.11 benefit from IEEPA tariff refunds.

highlights.headline: Target received $994M pre-tax IEEPA tariff refund in Q2, recorded as reduction of cost of sales; company investing in lower prices for guests.
highlights.quote_receiving: Our Q2 P&L included a $994 million pre-tax benefit from tariff refunds, which was recorded as a reduction of cost of sales.

highlights.headline: TJX received tariff refunds in Q2 and expects additional refunds in Q3; results reported on adjusted basis excluding these items.
highlights.quote_receiving: excludes the benefit from tariff refunds that we received in the second quarter and expect to receive in the third quarter

highlights.headline: Walmart received tariff refunds in Q2, boosting operating income by ~750 bps; company deploying proceeds into price investment.
highlights.quote_receiving: This includes the benefit from the receipt of tariff refunds in the quarter.

highlights.headline: Deere recognized $110M in Q3 IEEPA tariff refunds; total fiscal 2026 refunds stand at $382M with no further refunds expected.
highlights.quote_receiving: We recognized $110 million of incremental refunds in Q3, slightly above expectations, due to the timing of the Phase 2 IEEPA refund approvals.

highlights.headline: Nordson pursuing tariff recoveries for selected tariffs but says overall tariff and recovery impact is not material to results.
highlights.quote_receiving: where we have potential, we are pursuing recoveries for selected tariffs like everybody else

highlights.headline: Ross Stores received $253 million (~$0.60 EPS) in tariff refunds in H1 2026, contributing 405 basis points to Q2 gross margin.
highlights.quote_receiving: both the second quarter and first six months results in 2026 include $253 million or approximately $0.60 in earnings per share of tariff refunds.

highlights.amount: $0.84 per share benefit (Q1); $0.60 net benefit for full year)
highlights.headline: Smucker received $0.84/share tariff refund in fiscal Q1; reinvesting portion in SG&A/marketing and using balance to pay down debt.
highlights.quote_receiving: we did receive an $0.84 benefit from tariff refunds in our first quarter

highlights.headline: Agilent received $20M net tariff refunds in Q3, boosting operating margin by ~110 bps and EPS by $0.06.
highlights.quote_receiving: Including the net benefit from tariff refunds of $20 million, our operating margin was 28.3%.

highlights.headline: Bath & Body Works received ~$80M in tariff refunds in Q2 2026, contributing ~530 bps to merchandise margin.
highlights.quote_receiving: adjusted earnings per diluted share included the benefit from approximately $80 million of tariff refunds received in the quarter.

highlights.headline: HP received tariff refunds in Q3; $0.11 EPS benefit, results above guidance even excluding this amount.
highlights.quote_receiving: our net earnings per share at $0.83 grew 11% and includes $0.11 related to tariff refunds

highlights.headline: Best Buy received $34M in IEEPA tariff refunds in Q2 FY2027, boosting gross profit rate; similar refunds expected in Q3.
highlights.quote_receiving: a higher gross profit rate that included a $34 million benefit from tariff refunds

highlights.headline: Dollar General received tariff refund payments in Q2, reinvesting substantial portion in lower prices, promotions, and customer-facing initiatives.
highlights.quote_receiving: we also received tariff refund payments during the quarter and reinvested a substantial portion, primarily to further enhance the overall value proposition for our customers
highlights.quote_customers: we delivered additional savings through both targeted promotional activities, particularly around the important summer holidays and lower everyday prices

highlights.headline: Dollar Tree received ~$383M in tariff refunds and is reinvesting proceeds in pricing, marketing, store operations, and store conditions.
highlights.quote_receiving: We received approximately $383 million, giving us a meaningful opportunity to reinvest in the business and further strengthen our value proposition for our customers.
